items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: He said, that something -- there is another thing about it. He never would buy people drinks, you know. People couldn't understand why he would buy me a drink. So I said, well, Bean, have one on me. No, no, this one's on me. We're buddies from way back. I said, yeah, we're buddies from way back.

ctx.x: But he was quite definite about that.

Because I know when he was down in 52nd Street before the war, I used to go down there and catch him. So the place called the White Rose, and all of these (unintelligible) 52nd Street would hang playing (unintelligible) in there, and I'd go down (I went up to Ben Webster) there to catch Hawk, and I saw (unintelligible). I said, hey, said, where's Bean? Hawk's down in that White Rose bar. So I said, okay. So I'd go on down to the White Rose bar. Hawk would be way in the back by himself. So I'd go in there and, ((…

He said, you come to hear me play, said, I'm going up to hear you play. I said, well, I'm right here to see you tonight, to be your buddy. He said, that something -- there is another thing about it. He never would buy people drinks, you know. People couldn't understand why he would buy me a drink. So I said, well, Bean, have one on me. No, no, this one's on me. We're buddies from way back. I said, yeah, we're buddies from way back. He said you 211 and he's still playing on them old, funny ideas you got. I said,…
